explanation.headline: Metoclopramide hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list; supply traces to multiple registered plants with VAI inspections

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include metoclopramide hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 44 units with 4.9 days of supply at 8.9 units per day, while Corvale General holds 256 units with 29.1 days at 8.8 units per day.
The ranked transfer option moves 82 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender with 20 days of supply and bringing the receiver to 14 days.
Execute the transfer per pharmacy director approval to rebalance inventory across sites.
